text:
Maria G.: quick heads-up — pen-test vendor just sent a proposed window but it collides with our infra freeze on 3/22. can we shift?
Alex R.: ugh, how long is their window?
Maria G.: TBD but they asked for a 48h access window starting 3/21 00:00 UTC.
Chris T.: we can't open RBAC and KMS creds during freeze. need a short dry-run earlier or push to 3/28+.
Maria G.: vendor says 3/28 is OK but wants retest slot within 7 days after fixes.
Jin (oncall): if we move, need to update escalation playbook + oncall rotation. I can cover if it's weekend but prefer weekday.
Alex R.: propose: do a 4h smoke test on 3/20 to validate assessor access (ephemeral roles), then full 48h on 3/28.
Sasha L.: that works for me. ops needs 48h lead to provision ephemeral roles + presigned evidence buckets.
Maria G.: @OpsBot can you create the ticket checklist for ephemeral KMS proxy + SSO role creation? include audit export samples?
OpsBot: created ticket INFSEC-4821 with checklist: [ephemeral-role, presigned-s3, kms-proxy, audit-stream, log-retention-sample]. link: https://internal/INFSEC-4821
Chris T.: tagging security-audit: for KMS integration — vendor needs decrypt-only to wrap test keys. we should do KMS proxy with limited principal. no direct CMK access.
Alex R.: agree. plan: create an external-facing key alias redwood/pt-assess-<env>-2026, grant kms:Decrypt to role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/pt-assessor-ephemeral for 48h. rotate alias after retest.
Sasha L.: also ensure CloudTrail is in read-only bucket with object lock enabled for week of test. send sample logs to vendor? we should only provide hashes, not raw records.
Maria G.: vendor requested sample audit entries for login and KMS usage to prove visibility. we can provide redacted entries.
Chris T.: sample snippet I'm proposing: ```json
{"eventTime":"2026-03-28T01:12:03Z","eventName":"Decrypt","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/pt-assessor-ephemeral/Session"},"requestParameters":{"keyId":"alias/redwood/pt-assess-2026"}}
```
Jin (oncall): perfect. also add an alert runbook: if we see >5 failed Decrypt attempts in 1h, auto-revoke ephemeral role and page infra-oncall.
Alex R.: adding to INFSEC-4821: runbook step -> `aws iam revoke-role --role pt-assessor-ephemeral` (or cloudformation rollback).
Sasha L.: on RBAC changes: we need to snapshot existing org roles and map to assessor perms. someone pair with me to author the role policy.
Chris T.: I can pair tomorrow 10:30 PT. will draft least-privilege policy.
Maria G.: remediation tracking: prefer using JIRA epic PT-2026 with child tickets for each vuln. vendor wants to re-run specific checks after fixes — we should tag fixes with `pt:fix-<id>` so retest automation can pick them.
Alex R.: make sure to include pre/post metrics: token counts, request latency, any redwood-internal model-serving endpoints touched. vendor only allowed to test control plane and staging. prod out-of-scope.
Maria G.: noted. we must update scope doc to explicitly exclude: prod, customer data buckets, and kube secrets.
Jin (oncall): incident response note: if vendor escalates a critical finding during window, we should suspend test immediately, capture forensics snapshot, and call the assessor POC before mitigation. defined in playbook.
Sasha L.: who is assessor POC? vendor contact is elena@sec-assess.com, phone +1-555-1023. add to ticket.
OpsBot: INFSEC-4821 updated with POC and runbook links.
Alex R.: retest coordination: vendor asked for automated evidence upload after each verification. we should provide pre-signed S3 path /pt-results/PT-2026/<check-id>/ and require checks to upload `evidence.json` and `stdout.log` only.
Chris T.: enforce s3 bucket policy to deny `PutObject` except from vendor IPs during window. I'll include the IP ranges in the ticket.
Maria G.: final ask: schedule a 30m pre-test dry run 24h before full window to validate ephemeral role creation, kms decrypt flow, and audit export. propose 3/27 18:00 UTC.
Sasha L.: calendar invite sent to #eng-security, #eng-infra, and vendor POC.
Jin (oncall): I'll be on the call.
Maria G.: thanks team. tagging @everyone for visibility. I'll keep INFSEC-4821 updated with remediation tracker and retest slots. :thumbsup:
